description:
Generate images from text descriptions using Google Gemini's image generation capabilities.

Use this when the user asks you to create, generate, draw, or design an image, illustration, or visual content using Gemini/Google AI.

The generated image will appear inline in the conversation. You can also save it to disk by providing save_path.

Tips for good prompts:
- Be specific about style, colors, composition, and mood
- Mention artistic styles if relevant (e.g., "watercolor", "minimalist", "photorealistic")
- Include details about lighting, perspective, and background

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image (default: 1:1)

image_size.description: Output resolution: "1K" (default, ~1024px), "2K", or "4K". Only sent to the Gemini 3 image models — gemini-2.5-flash-image always produces ~1K.

model.description: Model to use: "gemini-3.1-flash-image-preview" (Nano Banana 2, default — pro-quality at flash speed), "gemini-3-pro-image-preview" (Nano Banana Pro — highest quality), or "gemini-2.5-flash-image" (original Nano Banana — fast, legacy; ~1K output only)

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

save_path.description: Optional file path to save the image. IMPORTANT: Must be inside the workspace directory so the image can be displayed inline.

name: nano_banana_generate
title: Generate Image (Nano Banana)
